# ReplicatedVoiceConfig

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [ReplicatedVoiceConfig](index.html)(val mimeType: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val voiceSampleAudio: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val consentAudio: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val voiceConsentSignature: [VoiceConsentSignature](../-voice-consent-signature/index.html)? = null)

Configuration for a replicated (cloned) voice.

Either [consentAudio](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-replicated-voice-config/--root--.html) or a previously issued [voiceConsentSignature](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-replicated-voice-config/--root--.html) must accompany the sample; the signature avoids re-verifying the same consent on every request.
